objective: Compare model-reference feasible costs of at least LD1 and LD2 after candidate-owned shot selection; not certify ideal E[C] or a globally best split.

price_rule.tail: qR and prefix-specific coefficients reflect that prefix own normal-law event mix/basis/angle/phase via whole-wrapper calibration; not an exact additive event formula.

stages.seed_rule: Fixed carrier155529e2 trial_seed(physical_candidate,cohort,index,outer,0); freeze actual seed lists and SOURCE before physical preparation; not generated in this planning turn.

stages.receipt: Physical/configuration, LD, m, q/R/T, cohort/index/outer seeds, axis, event digest/order observations, same-path S/C, fingerprint/metrics, compiler/lowering/scalar/preparation identity, execution SOURCE and publication commit separately.
stages.gates: Same input/preparation/request/lowering/compiler/fingerprint checks as P2 fresh/m3; do not claim numerical action/full-wrapper statevector gates that original path did not run.

stages.purpose: Freeze LD2 model references and reuse LD1 table
stages.fit_target: C cell means; do not add measured S again because LD2 offset is zero
stages.long_round_assumption: Fixed prefix and S2/.1/K2/common-kappa schedule: average whole-wrapper price approximated by (1,q,qR) across m0..12. m7..12 extrapolate beyond q64/R40; order mix/angle, basis transitions and optimizer effects may break it.
stages.exclude: Do not refit LD1; keep LD1 m4 holdout independent, never pool P1/replay or Pauli LD2.
stages.model_gate: Fit rank/domain and finite positive 26 references required for the proposed inverse-price allocation rule; negative/zero/nonfinite prediction is not clipped or repaired automatically.
stages.fit_algorithm_use: Reuse _exact/_solve/predict arithmetic only as needed. A narrow wrapper declares the prefix2 schedule-family domain and retains cell-specific input-law references; do not blindly call generic fit with unequal point-law dicts or weaken its existing guard.

budget_policy.per_LD: beta times this LD own T_ref(LD,V0)

stages.algorithm: For each LD and rule choose the largest finite breakpoint lambda with sum_i N_i*C_ref_i <= beta*T0_L; N_i=max(1,min(V0_i,floor(lambda*w_i))); w_i=V0_i for A_SHAPE, V0_i/C_ref_i for B_PRICE.
stages.price_numeric_delta: Existing generator requires integer prices: adapt only price parsing/weights/sums to positive exact Fraction, with synthetic tests. No rounding of LD1 rational prices.
stages.deduplication: If a whole vector equals saved V0 or another accepted same-candidate vector, reuse it; ambiguous provenance/independence is held.
stages.evaluation: Each LD uses its own saved signal packet, law and total decoder binding. A new N has its own count/closure preflight; old closure PASS is not transferred.
stages.selection: For each LD select minimum reference cost among saved V0 and the at most two newly Q3-admitted vectors. Then compare the two LD minima within this finite menu; retain all ties, UNKNOWN and INCONCLUSIVE.
stages.not_claimed: Global optimal N, optimal LD, monotone MSE in N, physical sufficient N, certified E[C]/G/winner.

technical_preparation_before_execution: Use NativeRuntime/Adapter request-specific prefix2 and corrected c+s_R; historical C1 Backend.context is H4-prefix1 and must not be called as LD2 context.

The e8273676 adapter calls fast.make_backend_class(..., axes=..., observer=...). Pin the matching 26d4f23e/e8273676 fast SOURCE (blob44b0f8cc); current LD1 fast blob6c3d7be5 has only (base,science), so it is not a drop-in native adapter runtime.

For LD2 model arithmetic reuse price_model_validation._solve/predict. Its generic fit requires exact equality of the law dictionaries across records; preserve each cell own tau/order/law receipt and use an explicit fixed-prefix schedule-family model wrapper rather than relabelling different point laws as equal.

New finite caller must select only m0/m3/m6 and preserve old T2/m12 STOP. Freeze implementation, identity, inputs, seeds, output/cache and exact model/whole-vector rules before each corresponding scientific stage.
Reuse the existing source/input loader and Gaussian/lowering pipeline; synthetic tests cover the actual prefix2 entry and exact-rational allocation path. No saved-H4-operator regression suite.
Keep independent path concurrency and cooperative stage timing; do not reuse historical resource caps as new permanent limits or periodic faulthandler on Python3.11.0rc1.
next_execution_delta_check: After planning commit: same configuration/physical/axis/law/lowering/profile/cohort seed receipts or model publications, existing plan execution status and named jobs.
Check output/cache collisions and actual execution SOURCE/input/compiler changes; source-bound equivalents reduce new acquisitions.
Recheck whether any same-candidate Q3 with exactly the generated vector exists before launching it; preserve fixed raw and prior STOP.
STOP: Planning turn stops after publication/remote verification; all finite stages remain unexecuted.
During later authorized package: input/source/scalar/phase/axis/receipt mismatch, acquisition/save failure => stop new submissions and preserve partials; no automatic retry/seed/path changes.
Incomplete fixed calibration, rank failure, model profile mismatch, or nonpositive/nonfinite reference for inverse-price rule => stop; no clipping/new feature/extra cell/refit fallback.
A new vector that cannot pass metadata/count/closure feasibility is held; Q3 budget at most4 and one attempt per unique candidate/vector.
Q3 model failure/inconclusive is a finite outcome, not permission for another vector; no post-result budget change.
After finite two-split report and remote check stop. LD3/other split, LD2 m4/m9 holdout, new signal, new width/kappa/K and all-law/CI work need a later decision.
decision_after_comparison: Compare minimum admitted reference cost per LD with that LD own selected vector and source-specific model qualification. A cheaper fixed-shot price is not sufficient.

Inspect Q3 outcomes and weighted per-round costs to determine whether ordering relies on untested m7..m12 extrapolation. If so prefer a separately planned LD2 long-round measurement before expanding LD.
If the LD2 head/tail tradeoff remains informative under the model assumptions, propose the adjacent descriptor-ready LD3 next; even LD2 losing cannot globally prune LD3/5/7/9.
Do not select LD0 or zero-tail LD10 by relabelling Full-H RTE or PF; those need boundary definitions.
